correctness.rationale: Stationary existence and uniqueness follow from an explicit uniform angular-refresh coupling and harmonic contraction. The exact stationary complex-moment generator recursion yields the second and fourth active moments. An independent 4-time ordered angular integral reproduces the fourth moment. Gaussian OU convolution preserves fourth cumulant sign and gives the displayed positive thermal factor. Threshold, sharp rate floor and two-moment inverse were algebraically checked including all strict and equality boundaries. The provided reproducible verifier passes 1532 exact-rational parameter cases; the proof, not finite tests, covers all allowed real parameters.

value.rationale: Preferred directional reorientation is empirically motivated and its two angular Fourier coefficients control distinguishable physics. The complete positive/negative stationary kurtosis transition isolates an unexpectedly leptokurtic confined distribution despite bounded propulsion and no positional resetting. The sharp 1/3 mixture threshold and thermal-noise sign invariance provide a structural phase diagram, while exact two-moment identification makes the result a specific interpretable diagnostic; these are not merely a parameter substitution or a known-table recomputation.
